ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.Bypass_Color_Review_Gates) && ISCHANGED(CapStrat_Stage__c) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(CapStrat_Stage__c), "Response In Progress") && OR(ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Submitted - Awaiting Customer Decision"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "RFP Shortlisted"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Shortlisted - Awaiting Customer Decision"), ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Awarded")) && OR(NOT(Blue_Pricing_Approved__c), NOT(Green_QC_Complete__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before a bid can be marked Submitted, Shortlisted or Awarded, the Blue Review Pricing Approved box and the Green Review Final QC Complete box must both be checked. Cancelling or no-bidding is still allowed.
